item.title: Dan Patrick Radio Hall of Fame Acceptance Speech 2021 Chicago
item.description: Jonathon Brandmeier emcee’s the 2021 Radio Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony at Wintrust where Dan Patrick is inducted into the class of 2021. Will Ferrell introduces Dan Patrick and Dan shares his emotional philosophy on broadcasting, radio and credits influences like a Howard Stern.

item.title: Florida Democratic Attorney General Candidate Vows To "Fight" With Governor Ron DeSantis | WCKG - Bloomberg Business Radio - Dave Ramsey - Money Talks
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. — Jim Lewis, Democratic Attorney General candidate for the state of Florida, is ready for a fight. During a pro-choice abortion rally this past weekend, Lewis was asked about his willingness to work with current Florida Governor Ron DeSantis on policy-related issues.

item.title: Florida Democratic Attorney General Candidate Declares “That’s NOT My Group” In Response To Large Moms For Liberty Protest | WCKG - Bloomberg Business Radio - Dave Ramsey - Money Talks
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. — Jim Lewis, Democratic candidate for Attorney General of Florida, found himself in hot water with prospective voters from his own party this past weekend. During an organized pro-choice protest, Lewis and his party were repeatedly insulted for their inability to codify abortion into law. When asked about his affiliation with the group, Lewis firmly responded, claiming it was not his.“That’s not my group, but I am with them,” Lewis said to former U.S. Senate candidate Matt Dubiel.

item.title: Florida Democratic Attorney General Candidate Still Wants Restrictions on Abortion | WCKG - Bloomberg Business Radio - Dave Ramsey - Money Talks
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. — Jim Lewis, Democratic candidate for Attorney General of Florida, ruffled some feathers during an abortion protest this past weekend.Attendees chanted, “Abortion is a human right. Fight! Fight! Fight!” as they marched near the Samaria Cafe in Tampa, Florida. Lewis was seen talking with the crowd before being asked about his personal stance on the issue.

item.title: Protestors Turn On Democratic Party, Chant “Do-Nothing Democrats” In Florida | WCKG - Bloomberg Business Radio - Dave Ramsey - Money Talks
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. — Protestors in Tampa, Florida this past weekend turned on their own party in the name of abortion rights.Advocates for the practice chided Democratic leadership by repeatedly chanting, “Do-Nothing Democrats” in response to the party’s inability to codify Roe v. Wade into law.
